bosses.name: Nek'zali the Soulcoiler
bosses.summary: Race the boss's Energy bar while burning shielded Amani adds before they reach the Well, then kill him after an Echo intermission.
tank: Swap at roughly 5-6 Hollowing Strikes stacks so the active tank eats the last stack before Possession Barrage.
Drag Possession Barrage away from the raid; nobody stands between boss and tank.
Park the Echo on corpse piles so Hungering Pyre's soak clears them.
healer: Cooldowns for each Soulcoil Ignition, which stacks Soulcoil Rite on everyone.
Dispel Essence Rend only after the target reaches the room edge.
Phase 2 Rite stacks never fall off, so raid damage keeps climbing.
dps: Magic damage breaks the Restless Amani absorb shields; physical is weak here.
Each Amani reaching the Well adds 5 Energy to the boss.
Kill the two Echoes of Jawae one at a time in the intermission.
everyone: Boss casts Uncoiled Rage at 100 Energy; each Soulcoil Ignition gives 25.
Dodge Anguished Echoes after Soulcoil Ignition.
Group-soak Hungering Pyre on the active tank during the intermission.
heroic: Dead adds leave a Vessel of Awakening and Corpse Blight hits players within 15 yards.
Missed Hungering Pyre soaks cause Slithering Flame; burn stray corpses to clear it.
mythic: Grasping Depths pulls the raid toward the Well until the Drowned Echo dies; teams rotate inside.
Avoid Swirling Spirit beams or gain Soul Exhaustion for 1 minute.
Invoke interrupts all casting and silences those players for 3 seconds.

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.note: Energy race with Soulcoil Ignition, Amani adds and Essence Rend.

phases.name: Intermission
phases.note: Two Echoes of Jawae spawn via Soul Transfer; soak Hungering Pyre.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.note: Energy resets; Bloodlust and kill before 100 Energy while Invoke stacks Rite permanently.

bosses.name: Entombed Sentinels
bosses.summary: Two unlinked Sentinels must be held 40+ yards apart by split groups and damaged evenly.
tank: Swap bosses after every intermission so Mark stacks reset.
Mitigate Empowering Slam and Bloodvenom Injection; both grow on the same tank.
Taunt the boss you did not tank last before returning to your side.
healer: Damage peaks at the end of each boss sequence; spend cooldowns there.
Dispel Blighted Blood quickly to fit a second dispel in.
dps: Kill Venom Coagulation first; it pulses raid damage while alive.
Keep your side's health even with the other group so Vitriolic Stasis heals little.
Step on Toxic Droplets before they erupt.
everyone: Bosses within 40 yards gain Ula'tek's Dominance and take 99% less damage.
Helical Toxins: collide so toxin counts total exactly 4 (1+3 or 2+2).
Move Clinging Murk from Unstable Miasma toward corners or old puddles.
heroic: Popped Toxic Droplets release Living Venom heading back to the boss; stay out of its path.
Helical Toxins totals above 4 kill the players involved; expired Murk leaves Blood Venom pools.

phases.name: Main phase
phases.note: Split raid, Breath of Ula'tek and Blood of Ula'tek sides with their own mechanics.

phases.name: Intermission
phases.note: Vitriolic Stasis equalizes health; solve Helical Toxins, then tanks swap.

bosses.name: Vashnik the Malignant
bosses.summary: Steer Vashnik so Imbibe empowers chosen venom fountains, then kill each fountain's adds before they reach the center.
tank: Swap on every Dripping Fangs and use a defensive for the hit.
Stand Vashnik between the two fountains you want next; get close for the far Blood fountain.
Keep adds within cleave range.
healer: Top up Exploding Infection targets as they run out; early dispels detonate sooner.
Siphoning and Stygian Infection put heal absorbs on players; stack or heal to clear them.
Each Expulsion is raid-wide damage when its fountain is empowered.
dps: Priority: Burning Venoms, then Clotting Venom, then Shrouded Venoms.
Clotting Venom splits into smaller adds on death, twice.
Bloodlust on pull.
everyone: Any add reaching the Malignant Cavity triggers Malignant Burst.
Do not use the same fountain more than twice in a row.
Aim Plague Wave lines away from the raid.
heroic: Caustic Surge leaves a DoT, so never kill two Burning Venoms together.
Catalytic Bile drops ground soaks that each need at least one player.
mythic: Imbibe also pulls Malignant Tumors; Plague Wave must strip their Hardened Tumor first.
Malignant Burst adds a 1-minute stacking DoT.

bosses.name: The Lost Explorers
bosses.summary: Council of Trader Gebbo, First Mate Nama and Scrollsage Iku; feed each a fish to trigger their ultimate in turn.
tank: Swap after each Shredding Shards stack from Iku.
Defensives at high Steady Strikes stacks from Nama.
Hold Nama between Gebbo and Iku for cleave without all three stacking.
healer: Players with many Splinters bleed stacks take extra damage.
Frostfire Volley is the big raid damage window; plan cooldowns.
dps: Interrupt every Icebound Flames with a 2-3 person rotation.
Ranged hit by Blink Nova move away from the group.
Melee bait Nama's Shell Spin toward the edge.
everyone: All three within 30 yards gain United Defense (99% damage reduction).
Feed the Grab Fish before Mor'zahi's Empower finishes or Empowered Ascension wipes the raid.
Recommended ultimate order: Gebbo, Nama, then Iku.
mythic: Relic Rupture: breaking a crate applies Splinters to the raid.
Crates left unbroken for 25 seconds deal extra raid damage.

bosses.name: Sszorak
bosses.summary: Tank-combo-heavy serpent fight with raid soaks, wind pairings and a cyst-pushing intermission.
tank: Apex Predator: two Ravage, two Mutilate, one Tempest in random order; swap after the first Ravage or Mutilate.
Point Ravage away from the raid and use a defensive.
Corroding Venom stacks; swapping near 6 lines up with combo swaps.
healer: Mutilate soaks spread damage across the raid; soakers take a big damage-taken debuff on Heroic.
dps: Bloodlust on pull.
Save cooldowns for Dig In, when Sszorak takes 30% more damage for 25 seconds.
Stack loosely behind the boss in your Mutilate group.
everyone: Raging Crosswinds: pair with someone blown the opposite way.
Venomous Surge players drop Viscous Cysts on markers opposite the wind tunnels.
Dodge Tempest tornadoes.
heroic: Two Mutilate soak groups needed (or a Blood DK solo-soak).
Caustic Claws leaves Caustic Residue; standing in it raises damage taken 30%.
mythic: Serpent's Fury builds rage; at 100 Unbound Ferocity wipes the raid.
To the Slaughter fires once 14 players stand within 8 yards of the marked player.
Raging Crosswinds blow in four directions.

phases.name: Main phase
phases.note: Apex Predator combos, Venomous Surge cysts and Raging Crosswinds.

phases.name: Intermission
phases.note: Howling Maelstrom winds push players into cysts; Dig In damage window.

bosses.name: The Twin Fangs
bosses.summary: Vexhul and Ithraz, two serpents with separate health; manage permanent Eternal Venom stacks before an 8-minute enrage.
tank: Stay in melee even while adds are up.
Take all three Stone Breaker impacts, then swap.
Vile Flood beam always starts on the tank.
healer: Stacks of Eternal Venom raise damage over the fight; soak Ravenous Feast to remove one.
dps: Spawn of Vexhul adds are top priority.
Players hit by Corrosive Spit reposition once then stay put.
Keep both bosses at similar health.
everyone: Low-stack players soak Caustic Globules.
Coiling Ichor targets drop Congealed Gore at the edge.
Dodge Stir the Depths waves and Vile Flood beams.
heroic: 10 Eternal Venom stacks kills a player.
Feasted limits each player to one Ravenous Feast soak; three teams needed.
mythic: Caustic Globules gain Barbed Bulwark shields that must be interrupted.
Rouse the Brood adds must be interrupted; Tainted Blood must be soaked within 8 seconds.

phases.name: Main phase
phases.note: Vexhul and Ithraz mechanics; repeats twice.

phases.name: Submerge intermission
phases.note: Both bosses submerge; avoid Vile Flood and Sanguine Storm.

bosses.name: The Coiled Altar
bosses.summary: Fight Zul'jan, then Hex Lord Malacrass, then both together; balance damage since they don't share health.
tank: Swap after every Sever or Soul Sever.
Aim frontals through venom orbs or Manifestations.
Grab three Soul Fragments right after Soul Sever.
healer: Several orbs popping together means heavy raid damage.
Rotate cooldowns through the intermission Fragment soaks.
dps: Break Veil of Twilight and interrupt Eternal Nightfall late in the cast.
Use Bloodlust in the intermission when Zul'jan takes 100% more damage.
Keep both bosses stacked for cleave in Phase 3.
everyone: Guillotine needs at least 5 soakers, who then run out of Widow's Kiss.
Avoid Axegrinder axes.
Manifestations chase their target unless the target faces them.
heroic: Guillotined soakers take 500% more from the next one; use two soak groups.
Spiritcackle adds cast Wail of Terror and must be interrupted.
mythic: Virulent Cyst launches extra orbs every 6 seconds; kill it first.
Axegrinder axes stay out, shrinking safe space.
Manifestations are only visible to their fixated player.

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.note: Zul'jan: collect venom orbs, Sever, Guillotine soaks.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.note: Malacrass: Dreadmarch mind control, Manifestations, Gloombomb.

phases.name: Intermission
phases.note: Soulbinding; intercept Fragments of Malacrass before they heal Zul'jan.

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.note: Both bosses with all mechanics; the survivor enrages when one dies.

bosses.name: Ula'tek
bosses.summary: Final boss: ferry eggs, burn the exposed Venomous Heart, then survive as the arena breaks apart.
tank: One tank on the boss, one on the tail; swap during Caustic Waves.
Mother's Wrath leaves a DoT and Hobbled; use a slow-removal like Blessing of Freedom.
Point the Anguished Cry frontal away from the raid.
healer: Stack on the Doomscale Warden in Phase 2 for easier healing.
One healer group soaks a Serpent's Bite in Phase 3.
dps: Kill Blightscale Vipers fast.
Heroism about 5 seconds before the Venomous Heart is exposed (20 seconds, 100% more damage).
Interrupt Vicious Echoes and Anguished Cry; kill Blightscale Clutches quickly.
everyone: Getting hit by Caustic Waves while carrying an egg spawns a Viper.
Spread after soaking; Volatile Purge detonates 5 seconds later.
Circling Prey breaks platforms in Phase 3.
heroic: Split into two equal groups, each soaking one Spectral Coils in Phase 1 and the intermission.

phases.name: Phase 1
phases.note: Carry eggs to Spectral Coils, dodge Caustic Waves, then Heart window.

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.note: Split onto side platforms; Doomscale Warden, Grasping Fangs, Doomscale Cauldron.

phases.name: Intermission
phases.note: Alternating teams soak Spectral Coils; arena shatters into four platforms.

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.note: Serpent's Bite soaks, Circling Prey platform breaks, final Heart phase.

unverified: Raid has 8 bosses per Blizzard, Wowhead and Icy Veins, not 10.
Order follows Blizzard's announced boss list; Raid Finder wings group bosses differently (Twin Fangs is in Wing 1).
Icy Veins says players choose Sentinels or Lost Explorers after Nek'zali, and guides disagree on Vashnik/Sszorak/Twin Fangs order; in-game kill order may be non-linear.
Entombed Sentinels Mythic section on Icy Veins describes Shifting Protovenom, apparently a Vashnik mechanic; omitted.
Ula'tek Mythic not yet covered by Icy Veins.
Lost Explorers has no separate Heroic section; soak team split inconsistent in guide.
Warcraft Logs zone 53 page could not be fetched to confirm encounter order.
Playnews.gg article uses wrong boss names; not used.
